changes.summary: Retained power time after ignition off goes from 45 s to 60 s. The door-open cut-off is unchanged.
The trigger changes from the rain sensor to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll. The close is now an express close with anti-pinch active, where before it was only 'quickly'. This is a different function.
The pinch detection threshold drops from 100 N to 80 N. Detection is more sensitive, so the risk of false reversals rises.
The minimum reversal distance goes from 125 mm to 150 mm. The 10 ms stop time is unchanged.
Rewording only: 'set itself to not normalized' becomes 'set its state to not normalized'. The 500 ms threshold and the behaviour are unchanged.
The vague 'limit' and 'safe value' become numbers: temperature above 130 °C and current limited to 15 A. 'Reduce' also becomes 'limit'. The test is now objective.
The WLC_Status period goes from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. The content is unchanged.
The requirement now covers only storing B1A02 (above 25 A for more than 50 ms). Stopping the motor and setting the fault state have moved to the new WLC-037 and WLC-038.

tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-032. The test stays because it still verifies WLC-004 (sleep mode). See the concern about where the 100 µA limit now comes from.

tests.new_procedure: Switch ignition off. Press the switch at 50 s and at 70 s, which are either side of the new 60 s boundary. Repeat with a front door opened at 10 s, then press the switch. Also remove the trace to deleted WLC-023.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Window movement after ignition off, with switch pressed at 50 s
new_pass_criteria.limit: Movement allowed (60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first)

new_pass_criteria.measure: Window movement after ignition off, with switch pressed at 70 s
Window movement after a front door is opened at 10 s
new_pass_criteria.limit: No movement (until a front door is opened)

tests.reason: WLC-007 changed from 45 s to 60 s, so the 40 s and 50 s test points no longer bracket the boundary. WLC-023 was deleted.

tests.new_procedure: With the window half open and the controller normalized, send the CAN request WLC_CloseAll from the body controller. Repeat with a pinch rod in the closing path. Also send a rain signal alone and record the result. Retitle the test to 'Close on WLC_CloseAll'.

new_pass_criteria.limit: Anti-pinch protection active (pinch detected and window reverses)

tests.reason: The trigger, the closing mode and the anti-pinch requirement all changed, so the old rain-signal test no longer verifies WLC-012.

tests.new_procedure: At 13.5 V and 23 °C, express close onto the 10 N/mm pinch rod placed at 100 mm. Use the new thresholds. Include vibration (see the rough-road lesson). Choose the start position so that the 150 mm reversal or the fully open limit can be checked.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Motor stop time after the pinch force exceeds the threshold
new_pass_criteria.limit: Within 10 ms, with pinch force exceeding 80 N
At least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

tests.reason: The force threshold changed to 80 N and the reversal distance to 150 mm.

tests.new_procedure: As updated TC-AP-01, at 9.0 V and -30 °C. This is the worst-case stop-time corner, so run it on every software release.

tests.reason: It inherits the changed criteria from TC-AP-01.
Remove the trace to deleted WLC-018. Keep the test and re-trace it to WLC-014, because the 80 N threshold makes false reversals more likely (see the concern).
The WLC-021 change is editorial. The 500 ms behaviour and the 400 ms and 600 ms test points are still valid.

tests.new_procedure: Run open-close cycles until the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C. Then command a movement and measure the motor current. Confirm first that the estimate is current (see the thermal module concern).

new_pass_criteria.measure: Motor current once the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C

tests.reason: WLC-025 now gives a numeric temperature and current limit, so 'motor current reduced' is no longer an adequate criterion.

tests.new_procedure: Record WLC_Status for 10 s while moving the window. Repeat under worst-case bus load, including an active diagnostic session.

new_pass_criteria.measure: Signals present: window position, movement state, normalization state, fault state

tests.reason: The period changed from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms. The frame-loss lesson also requires a test under worst-case bus load.

tests.new_procedure: Block the window and inject 27 A for 100 ms. Add a boundary check below the threshold, for example 23 A for 100 ms and 27 A for 40 ms, to confirm B1A02 is not stored. The motor-stop and fault-state checks move to WLC-037 and WLC-038 (see the added requirements).

new_pass_criteria.measure: DTC B1A02 after motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms

tests.reason: WLC-030 now covers only storing the DTC. The stop and fault-state checks now belong to WLC-037 and WLC-038.
Its only trace, WLC-033 ('user friendly'), was deleted, so the test verifies nothing in the new version.

added.extend_test: Extend TC-DG-02 and add a trace to WLC-037. After B1A02 is stored by the 27 A, 100 ms injection, check that the motor stops. This keeps the stop check that WLC-030 used to carry.
added.pass_criteria: Motor stopped after B1A02 is stored. Record the stop time and compare it with WLC-031 if that requirement applies.

added.extend_test: Extend TC-DG-02 and add a trace to WLC-038. After B1A02 is stored, check the fault state signal in WLC_Status (50 ms period).
added.pass_criteria: Fault state set in WLC_Status after B1A02 is stored.

added.extend_test: A new test is needed, for example TC-AP-10 'Express close inhibit after pinch reversal'. First check whether TC-AP-08 (WLC-019, repeated pinch lockout) can be extended instead. Procedure: trigger a pinch reversal, then request express close at 1.5 s and at 2.5 s after the reversal. Also test manual close during the 2 s, and whether another pinch inside the 2 s restarts the timer.
added.pass_criteria: Express close is inhibited at 1.5 s after the pinch reversal. Express close works at 2.5 s. Inhibit duration is 2 s. The reference point for the 2 s must be confirmed with the requirement owner.

concerns.concern: The 80 N threshold (WLC-014) makes false pinch detection more likely. The lesson LL-2021-07 says a threshold change needs a new check of both false reversals and stop time. Keep TC-AP-09 (vibration, rough road), re-trace it to WLC-014 and rerun it at 80 N. Deleting WLC-018 must not remove the only false-reversal test. Consider also running the other AP tests with vibration.

LL-2022-02 says the cold, low-voltage corner is the worst case for stop time. TC-AP-04 uses 9.0 V and -30 °C. Run it on every software release, not only at the end. The 150 mm reversal may also take longer in that corner.

The 100 µA sleep limit was in deleted WLC-032. Confirm that WLC-004 still states a sleep current limit. If it does not, the test has no requirement behind its pass criterion, and the deletion may be a mistake. Also, the procedure waits 60 s after sleep entry. Check that this still makes sense with the 60 s retained power time (WLC-007).

Rain-triggered closing has been removed with no replacement, and no test now covers rain. Confirm that this is intended and not a safety or feature loss. Also check whether WLC_CloseAll should work when the controller is not normalized. TC-MV-08 (WLC-013, WLC-017) and TC-AP-07 (anti-pinch off when not normalized) may conflict with the new 'express with anti-pinch active' wording.

LL-2024-01 says a limit check using an estimate must use a current estimate. The platform thermal module is shared with WLC-200, so check that the fix is present before relying on the 130 °C result. Review TC-TH-01 (thermal model accuracy), TC-TH-03 and TC-TH-04 too. They do not trace to a change but depend on the same limit.

LL-2024-09 says to repeat the worst-case queue calculation when the cycle time is shortened from 100 ms to 50 ms. Do this analysis. Test under worst bus load, including diagnostic sessions. A 5 ms jitter budget leaves much less margin.

This test (WLC-031, diagnostic response time) does not trace to a changed requirement. WLC-030 was split into WLC-037 and WLC-038, so check that its limits and pass criteria still match the new traces and that nothing was lost in the split.

The reversal distance is 150 mm or fully open, whichever is less. With the rod at 100 mm, make sure the start position leaves at least 150 mm of travel. Otherwise the test checks the 'fully open' branch instead.

This test covers full function across the supply range (WLC-001). It does not trace to a change, but the new 80 N threshold and 150 mm reversal must also hold across that range. TC-AP-02 already covers part of it. Confirm that no gaps remain.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
